newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe calls convertible preferred.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe calls convertible preferred.

text.p: Santa Fe Energy Resources said Friday it had called for redemption all outstanding shares of its $0.732 Series A convertible preferred stock, effective May 15, 1997.

The redemption price, which will be payable in shares of Santa Fe common except for cash in lieu of fractional shares, will be 0.6773 of a share of Santa Fe common for each of the Series A Convertible Preferred shares. But holders exercising their right of conversion prior to the close of business on May 15 would receive 0.8474 of a share of Santa Fe common stock for each Series A preferred share.
There are currently 10,700,000 shares of the $0.732 Series A convertible shares outstanding.
